title: Frontend Engineer I
company_summary: Campfire makes group-planning apps for outdoor clubs and community events.
responsibilities: Build accessible, responsive product features in React and TypeScript
Own features end to end, from design review in Figma to production metrics
Improve web performance and Core Web Vitals across the app

requirements.text: 1+ years building production web apps with React and TypeScript
Strong HTML, CSS, and accessibility (WCAG) fundamentals
Experience with Next.js or another SSR framework
Experience testing UI with Jest and React Testing Library

description_text: Frontend Engineer I at Campfire (Remote, Canada). Campfire makes group-planning apps for outdoor clubs and community events. You will build accessible, responsive product features in React and TypeScript, own features end to end from Figma design review to production metrics, improve web performance and Core Web Vitals, and write tests for the component library. Requirements: 1+ years building production web apps with React and TypeScript; strong HTML, CSS, and accessibility (WCAG) fundamentals; experience testing UI with Jest and React Testing Library. Nice to have: Next.js or another SSR framework, GraphQL, comfort working from Figma designs, and a love of the outdoors.
